formatSource.title: Circular n.º 93 — Primera Federación de Fútbol Femenino, rules for 2026/27
coverage: Official competition name and 14-club, single-group format for 2026/27.
The regular season has 26 double round-robin matchdays.
The league winner earns direct promotion; positions 2–5 play two knockout rounds for a second promotion place.
The team finishing 14th is relegated to Segunda Federación.
